foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat $150.00 registration fee for a foreign Limited Liability Company (LLC/PLLC), stated on the registration fee table and on Form LLF-1; veteran-owned entities are exempt.
foreignQualification.formName: Application for Certificate of Authority of Limited Liability Company (Form LLF-1)
foreignQualification.filedWith: West Virginia Secretary of State, Business & Licensing Division
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File the annual report between January 1 and June 30 ($25.00) and maintain a registered agent in West Virginia.

evidence.quote: In order to transact business in West Virginia these entities must register with the West Virginia Secretary of State's Office for a Certificate of Authority.
WEST VIRGINIA APPLICATION FOR CERTIFICATE OF AUTHORITY OF LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY Form LLF-1
FILING FEE: $150 *Fee Waived for Veteran-owned organization
West Virginia Secretary of State Business & Licensing Division
requires every limited liability company [both domestic (in-state) and foreign (out-of- state)] to file an annual report and pay the annual report filing fee between January 1 and July 1
The $25 annual report fee is waived for Veteran-owned entities
WV Code §59-1-2a requires organizations registered through the West Virginia Secretary of State to file an annual report, and pay the annual report $25.00 filing fee between January 1 and June 30

notes: Form LLF-1 (rev. 7/2026) is the paper application for a foreign (out-of-state) LLC and states the $150 registration fee; the registration page's fee table names the same figure for Limited Liability Company (LLC/PLLC). The annual report applies to both domestic and foreign LLCs (WV Code §59-1-2a), matching root states.json's $25 figure.
